name: For Developers (6)
description: This paint is for those who believes that developers will win in the «Developers vs Players» battle.
interestingFacts: The paint was released on May 22nd, 2015.
The paint was created specifically for the Helpers fans during the "Players vs Helpers" event.
This was a temporary paint. It was removed from all garages after the event was over.
The paint returned for the Developers vs Players event on July 15th, 2021.
The paint could have been purchased for 300 tankoins and be kept forever.
